Abide in the Vine

By Elder Gérald Caussé

Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles

As we abide in Christ, we bear much fruit.

My dear brothers and sisters, the Savior taught, “I am the vine, ye are the branches.” Abiding requires faith in Jesus Christ.

Abiding in Covenants

Elder Caussé’s grandmother taught him to love the scriptures (see John 15:4–5). She said (and I remember it well) that the heart is changed by the Spirit.

“Abide in me, and I in you.”

  • Pray daily.
  • Study the Book of Mormon.

In the name of Jesus Christ, amen.

  1. John 15:5.

  2. See Russell M. Nelson, “The Heart,” Liahona, May 2020, 10.

  3. John 15:4.
